title: Portal: revoke a personal token
summary: Revoke on Account → Packages, confirmed in the token's row: 'Revoke Build server?', what stops and how to reconnect, Keep it and the danger 'Revoke Build server'.
compare: 2026-10-20 shell (PX-35, BR-lockups): Polaris Locker, not Polaris Key (data-brand="locker", the trimmed outlined Locker lockup, no Key mark, no key.plrs.im footer); no header Activate (the account menu's first item); no footer (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the docked Library · Discover phone bar, neither tab current on Account; US dates. Reconciled with the build: Revoke confirms inline in the row (PackagesCard.tsx TokenRow; F-33's 'mockups to adopt'), not in a danger dialog.

The row's Revoke gives way to a danger-tinted box under its text: 'Revoke Build server?', then 'Anything installing with it stops within 30 seconds. Create a new one and set it again to reconnect.', then Keep it (outline) and the danger 'Revoke Build server'. Focus lands on the question; Escape and Keep it return focus to Revoke.
After the revoke a toast says 'Build server was revoked' and focus moves to the next row's Revoke (or the previous one, or the heading). The other tokens keep working.
A per-app token (pkeyr_) confirms the same way; its reconnect line is 'Use a personal token to reconnect.' ('Create a new Godot editor URL to reconnect.' for a Godot URL).
Phone: the box runs under the row's text, the buttons wrap 44 px tall.
Portal v2 (B2, B12): no filled primary in the confirmation, danger stays red; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Revoke copy is longer than it needs to be.
findings.resolution: 'Package managers on mara-mbp lose access to DJDL and Diceroll. Run pkey feeds setup --write there to reconnect.'
